about: The parts a walkthrough stop can Point to, by the reader's words: map-viewer/test/query.js and scripts/test_query.py hold the viewer and the checker to these names.

cases.name: joins and clauses
cases.sql: SELECT o.id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id > 1 GROUP BY o.id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY o.id

cases.name: union inputs
cases.sql: SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.id > 1 UNION ALL SELECT c.id FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = c.id ORDER BY id

cases.name: subqueries numbered select, then joins, then clauses
cases.sql: SELECT o.id, (SELECT MAX(p.id) FROM payments p) AS top FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments q WHERE q.order_id = o.id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments r JOIN customers s ON s.id = r.id)

cases.name: derived table
cases.sql: SELECT d.id FROM (SELECT o.id FROM orders o WHERE o.id > 1) d LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = d.id
